{{Quote|The Empire controls Balmorra. The greatest weapons in the galaxy are now in the hands of its strongest power.|Riserre|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Riserre''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]] who was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an individual affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Satellite control tower]], shortly after he ordered the execution of the [[Hawkeyes]] technicians.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Admiral Riserre first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
